settings.title: Full-Grain Italian Calfskin
settings.text: Sourced from small family-run tanneries in Tuscany. Supple to the touch with a delicate pebble grain that develops a rich patina.

settings.title: Unstructured Ergonomic Slouch
settings.text: Drapes naturally under the arm without rigid cardboard stiffeners. Soft yet structured enough to stand on its base when set down.

settings.title: Custom Solid Brass Hardware
settings.text: Every buckle and magnetic closure is machined from solid brass and brushed to a warm satin finish that will never peel or rust.

settings.title: Reinforced Saddle Stitching
settings.text: Critical stress points are hand-tacked with high-tensile waxed thread, ensuring the shoulder strap remains secure through years of daily commute.

settings.heading: Every Seam Considered
settings.subhead: We build without compromise so that one bag serves for decades.
